original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Harden CentOS 9 Server
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true
  vars:
    ssh_port: 22
    allowed_ssh_users: []
    fail2ban_bantime: 3600
    fail2ban_findtime: 600
    fail2ban_maxretry: 5
    password_min_length: 14
    password_min_classes: 4

  tasks:

    - name: Ensure system is up to date
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: "*"
        state: latest
        update_cache: true
      tags: [packages, updates]

    - name: Install EPEL repository
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: epel-release
        state: present
      tags: [packages]

    - name: Install required hardening packages
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name:
          - fail2ban
          - fail2ban-firewalld
          - audit
          - audit-libs
          - libpwquality
          - firewalld
          - openssh-server
        state: present
      tags: [packages]

    # --- SSH HARDENING ---
    - name: Ensure SSH drop-in directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0755'
      tags: [ssh]

    - name: Deploy hardened SSH configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-hardening.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0600'
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - SSH Hardening
          Port {{ ssh_port }}
          Protocol 2
          PermitRootLogin no
          PasswordAuthentication no
          PermitEmptyPasswords no
          ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
          KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
          UsePAM yes
          X11Forwarding no
          AllowAgentForwarding no
          AllowTcpForwarding no
          PermitUserEnvironment no
          ClientAliveInterval 300
          ClientAliveCountMax 2
          LoginGraceTime 30
          MaxAuthTries 3
          MaxSessions 5
          IgnoreRhosts yes
          HostbasedAuthentication no
          StrictModes yes
          Banner /etc/issue.net
          LogLevel VERBOSE
          Ciphers chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com,aes256-gcm@openssh.com,aes128-gcm@openssh.com,aes256-ctr,aes192-ctr,aes128-ctr
          MACs hmac-sha2-512-etm@openssh.com,hmac-sha2-256-etm@openssh.com,umac-128-etm@openssh.com
          KexAlgorithms curve25519-sha256,curve25519-sha256@libssh.org,diffie-hellman-group16-sha512,diffie-hellman-group18-sha512
          {% if allowed_ssh_users | length > 0 %}
          AllowUsers {{ allowed_ssh_users | join(' ') }}
          {% endif %}
        validate: '/usr/sbin/sshd -t -f %s'
      notify: Restart sshd
      tags: [ssh]

    - name: Deploy SSH login banner
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/issue.net
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          **************************************************************************
          *                          AUTHORIZED ACCESS ONLY                        *
          * Unauthorized access is prohibited. All activity is monitored & logged. *
          **************************************************************************
      tags: [ssh]

    # --- PASSWORD COMPLEXITY ---
    - name: Configure password quality requirements (pwquality)
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/security/pwquality.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible
          minlen = {{ password_min_length }}
          minclass = {{ password_min_classes }}
          dcredit = -1
          ucredit = -1
          lcredit = -1
          ocredit = -1
          maxrepeat = 3
          maxclassrepeat = 4
          gecoscheck = 1
          dictcheck = 1
          usercheck = 1
          enforcing = 1
          retry = 3
          difok = 5
          enforce_for_root
      tags: [password]

    - name: Configure login.defs password aging
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/login.defs
        regexp: '^{{ item.key }}'
        line: '{{ item.key }} {{ item.value }}'
        state: present
      loop:
        - { key: 'PASS_MAX_DAYS', value: '90' }
        - { key: 'PASS_MIN_DAYS', value: '7' }
        - { key: 'PASS_WARN_AGE', value: '14' }
        - { key: 'PASS_MIN_LEN', value: '{{ password_min_length }}' }
        - { key: 'UMASK', value: '027' }
      tags: [password]

    - name: Configure password history (faillock & pwhistory)
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/security/pwhistory.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          remember = 5
          enforce_for_root
      tags: [password]

    - name: Configure account lockout (faillock)
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/security/faillock.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          deny = 5
          unlock_time = 900
          fail_interval = 900
          even_deny_root
          root_unlock_time = 900
      tags: [password]

    # --- FAIL2BAN ---
    - name: Configure fail2ban defaults
      ansible.builtin.copy:
